data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 冥界花田的散步·「在冥界种花……是我的任性」
data.description: 【冥界花田·花时】黑暗的国土上竟开着一整片白色的花田——是她一株一株亲手种下的。埃列什基伽勒提着裙摆走在花间，回头朝你招手，红瞳弯成温柔的弧度——「在冥界种花，是本王唯一的任性。……呐，你看，它们朝你开花了。花也是，我也是。」
data.action: 一手提稳黑裙裙摆，另一手回身招呼同行者，沿白花间小径行走
data.lighting: 花田上空的柔光与幽暗国土的对比
data.camera: medium shot, flower field walk, beckoning, tender mood
data.promptProse: Ereshkigal walks the underworld's narrow white-flower path, lifting a little black dress hem with one hand and turning back to beckon with the other. Pale-blue ribbons move beneath her gold tiara as her red eyes soften into a smile. The horizontal medium view follows the path beyond overlapping blossoms. Gentle magical light above the bed illuminates flowers and her offered hand, leaving the surrounding land dark and the gathered skirt folds distinct.
